newsitem.title: USA: CME July bellies see gains erased, then edge higher.
newsitem.headline: CME July bellies see gains erased, then edge higher.

text.p: CME pork belly futures saw early gains wiped out by commercial selling in the key July contract but then began to move higher again, traders said.

An early sharp advance was prompted partly by bullish weekly CME out-of-town storage data. The CME reported a net out-movement last week of 1.205 million lbs for the week ended April 26, far exceeding expectations. Some industry sources had expected in movement rather than out movement.
Funds and commission houses were early buyers.
Floor sources said, however, commercials sold into the rally with LFG, Rand and Refco featured amid sentiment that demand for bellies has slowed since April 26 following a rise in prices.
July pork bellies peaked early at 94.300 cents a lb, then fell back to 91.500 cents. At 1043 CDT July stood 0.800 cent up at 92.400 cents.
